thread:
Sasha: Quick follow-up on the model binding headers we talked about yesterday. Need to decide how tombstones show up in rollout metadata so clients can detect deprecations without heavy reconciliation.

Maria: +1. Suggest adding a "status" enum: "active" | "deprecated" | "tombstone" and a "since_ts" field.

Kevin: How do we ensure old clients don't misroute? Older clients should ignore unknown fields; but we should also include a short header: `X-Model-Compat: v1` for routing logic.

Maria: example metadata:
```
{"model_id":"redwood/large-v1","status":"tombstone","since_ts":1680000000,"replacement":"redwood/large-v2"}
```

Sasha: I prefer `visibility` instead of `status` (public | internal | tombstone) and an optional `expires_at` for automatic eviction.

Isha: CDN/cache note: we need cache-busting when visibility changes. Add `metadata-version` header so proxies can invalidate.

Kevin: Avoid boolean flags — need gradations (deprecated vs tombstone). Agree on `visibility` + `expires_at`.

deploy-bot: Schema v0.6 metadata change pushed to staging.

Maria: I'll open a tiny migration script to backfill tombstones for pinned models. CLI sketch:
```
redwood-admin model backfill --status tombstone --since 2024-03-01
```

Sasha: Cool. Next step: doc the client contract (ignore unknown fields, prefer header fallback). I'll draft the API section.

Kevin: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
